Riley: Heads-up: SDK snippets PR (#3678) failing linkcheck. The preview shows a 404 for the python SDK path in the sample.
Jin: Which link specifically?
Riley: The snippet links to /docs/sdk/python/quickstart but our python quickstart moved to /docs/sdk/py/quickstart last month. Linkcheck flagged it.
spell-bot: LINKCHECK: ERROR snippet-urls.md:23 - Broken link: /docs/sdk/python/quickstart -> 404
Riley: I'll update the snippet and also search other SDK pages for python -> py renames.
Jin: Can you do a repo-wide search? I can help patch. We should add a redirect in site config too so old links don't break.
Riley: Found 6 occurrences. Pushing fix and adding redirect in mkdocs.yml for /docs/sdk/python -> /docs/sdk/py.
reviewer-bot: Preview deploy created at https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-3678
spell-bot: Re-run: LINKCHECK: SUCCESS.
Jin: Nice. Small follow-up: for future renames let's add a CI step to warn on deprecated paths. I'll file an RFC.
Riley: Filed RFC DOCS-42. Approving my own fix to get it merged in the next docs slot.
